story: An icon of the skies, the Amur Paradise Fly Catcher (Terpsiphone incei) is a species from the Monarchidae family. It thrives in Broadleaf lowland and hill forests; also more open habitats during migration and winter, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Amur Paradise Fly Catcher is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Amur Paradise Fly Catcher helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife.
